critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 14,192 lines — should be split into routers (auth, reports, admin, payments) for maintainability; well beyond the 700-line guideline.

The upload submit button in UploadPage.jsx does NOT expose a data-testid (only text-based selector works: 'Start …Analysis'). Consider adding data-testid="upload-submit" to match the testing conventions used elsewhere in this file.

Admin dashboard's 'latest report' widget shows 'Generation was interrupted — Request failed with status code 404' for a stale in-progress report (id starting e0f848db…). Not caused by today's changes but user-visible eyesore — the auto full-report retry endpoint returns 404 for that legacy report; consider handling 404 by hiding the retry card or marking that report as terminally failed.
